# opx

> opx is a CLI plus plugins for linting, building, and releasing front-end projects. It scans the repository, finds what it needs, and runs it. It never prompts without a terminal, so an agent can set it up with `opx init --yes`.

To adopt opx: install `@allons-y/opx-cli`, run `opx scan --json`, then `opx init --yes` (add `--accept release` to enable releases), then `opx lint`.

## Start here

- [Use opx with an AI agent](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/guides/agents/): the step-by-step setup for agents.
- [Getting started](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/getting-started/): install and first run.

## CLI

- [opx init](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/cli/init/): set up, including `--yes` and `--accept`.
- [opx scan](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/cli/scan/): detect plugins; `--json` output.
- [opx enable](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/cli/enable/) and [opx disable](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/cli/disable/): toggle a plugin.
- [opx lint](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/cli/lint/): run linters.
- [opx build](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/cli/build/): run builders.
- [opx release](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/cli/release/): the changesets release flow.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/config/): every key in `.opx/config.json`.
- [Plugins](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/plugins/): lint-js, lint-ts, lint-json, lint-md, release.
- [Use opx in CI](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/guides/ci/)
- [Writing a plugin](https://projects.allons-y.studio/opx/guides/writing-a-detector/)
